key_idea: When the small cog turns once, the big cog turns by the same number of teeth.
steps: The small cog has 6 teeth and the big cog has 12 teeth.
When the small cog makes one full turn, 6 teeth of the big cog go past.
6 is half of 12, so the big cog makes half a turn. Its black tooth moves from the top to the bottom.
The small cog's black tooth goes all the way round and is back on top.

choice_feedback.A: The big cog makes half a turn, so its black tooth cannot still be on top.
choice_feedback.B: Half a turn moves the big black tooth to the bottom, not to the side.
choice_feedback.D: After one full turn, the small black tooth is back on top, not at the bottom.
choice_feedback.E: The small black tooth should be on top, and the big black tooth should be at the bottom.
